tips.text: Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at the first enemy in line; it knocks them back and the explosion slows them, so follow up with your carry's attacks.
Ultra Mega Fire Kick gives back some mana when it hits an enemy champion, so it is cheap to throw at enemies in lane.
Do not plan other spells right after starting Ultra Mega Fire Kick; Milio cannot cast anything else during its short delay.
Drop Cozy Campfire on your carry in trades; it adds attack range and heals, so they can hit from farther back.
Recast Cozy Campfire to send the hearth to another ally when the fight shifts.
Use Warm Hugs on your carry when enemies threaten them; the shield and speed help them escape or chase.
Save Breath of Life from level 6 for when allies are rooted, stunned or low; it cleanses most crowd control and heals.
Breath of Life does not cleanse airborne effects, so do not count on it against knock ups.
Stay near your allies; Milio's tools need them close, and he is easy to catch when alone.
Keep Ultra Mega Fire Kick for Alistar when he commits. It knocks him back and breaks his approach.
Stay close to your ally and keep Warm Hugs ready. The shield and speed help you survive Alistar's combo.
Stay away from Alistar's Pulverize range when you are alone. Headbutt can reach you from a long way off.
Use Breath of Life to cleanse your ally's stun after Alistar's combo. Airborne effects are not cleansed.
Kick Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Anivia when she steps up to cast; it knocks her back and stuns her, cutting off her combo.
Put Warm Hugs on your partner before Flash Frost lands; the shield and speed help them dodge Frostbite follow-ups.
Use Breath of Life to free allies caught by Flash Frost's stun.
Cozy Campfire gives extra attack range, so you can trade at range with Anivia and stay out of her reach.
Stay out of line with Cosmic Binding and keep a minion or your ally off the same line, since a second hit makes it stun.
Use Warm Hugs on your carry before Bard lands a bolt; the shield and speed help you get out.
Land Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Bard when he walks up for chimes or a shrine; the knockback interrupts his approach.
Walk over Bard's shrines to destroy them, so his ally cannot take the heal.
Save Breath of Life for when you are stunned or caught by Bard's bolt; it cleanses you and your allies.
Stay behind minions so Rocket Grab hits them first, because it only pulls the first enemy it meets.
Hit Blitzcrank with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he comes forward; he is knocked back and then slowed by the explosion.
Hold Warm Hugs for your carry when Blitzcrank is near, but know Static Field destroys shields.
Do not wander away from your allies; alone you are an easy grab and burst target.
Save Breath of Life to clear a stun or pull-based follow-up on your ally, but not the knock up.
Dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame; Brand needs one hit to start his combo, so stay out of his lines.
Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Brand when he steps up to cast; it knocks him back and stuns him, and the blast slows him.
Spread out from your carry; Brand's Conflagration and Pyroclasm hit groups hardest.
Put Warm Hugs on whoever Brand targets with Sear; a shield soaks the burst.
Save Breath of Life to cleanse Brand's Sear stun on your carry.
Stay out of a straight line with Braum when you cast Ultra Mega Fire Kick; his Unbreakable destroys it.
Use Warm Hugs on the ally Braum marks; the speed helps them leave before the stun lands.
Keep Breath of Life ready for Glacial Fissure; it cleanses the knock up and slows only if it is not airborne.
Stay near your carry; alone you are an easy Winter's Bite target.
Stay close to your allies. Camille wants to catch you alone, and your abilities work best near teammates.
Hit Camille with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she dashes in. It knocks her back and stuns her, which breaks her dive.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Camille jumps in. The shield and speed help them survive her stun.
Save Breath of Life for after she locks onto someone with The Hextech Ultimatum. It cleanses crowd control and heals.
Stay out of a straight line with Janna and your carry, because Howling Gale charges quietly and knocks you up for longer the more she charges it.
Hit Janna with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she is alone; it stuns her and slows her afterward, so she can't easily set up her Howling Gale.
Keep Cozy Campfire on your carry in a fight; the extra attack range lets them hit Janna and her partner from further away.
Save Breath of Life for when Janna's Howling Gale or Monsoon lands on your team; it cleanses the effects and the heal follows.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Zephyr lands so the shield and speed soften the damage.
Stay out of a straight line with Karma so Inner Flame hits a minion instead of you; it stops at the first unit it hits.
Break away from Karma's Focused Resolve tether by walking out of range before it ends, and you avoid the root.
Land Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Karma when she steps up; she has no escape of her own, and a hit refunds mana.
Save Breath of Life for when Karma roots your carry; it cleanses the root.
Keep Cozy Campfire on your carry so they can trade from farther away and heal off Karma's poke.
Keep Warm Hugs ready on yourself or your carry when Leona engages. The shield and extra speed help you break away.
Hit Leona with Ultra Mega Fire Kick as she walks in. It stuns her and knocks her back, which stops her engage.
Save Breath of Life for after Leona's stun or root lands. It cleanses the crowd control on you and your allies.
Stay near your partner. Alone you are an easy target for Leona's Zenith Blade.
Step away from Leona when she raises Eclipse. Her damage comes only when the shield ends.
Fire Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Lulu when she steps up to poke; the knockback and slow ruin her trade.
Stay out of Glitterlance's long line; both bolts slow you, so step sideways early.
Keep Warm Hugs ready for your carry when Lulu goes for Whimsy; the shield and speed help them escape.
Save Breath of Life for when Wild Growth knocks your team up; it won't cleanse that.
Stay behind your own minions or allies. Light Binding only roots the first two enemies it hits, so keep out of its line.
Save Breath of Life for when you or your carry is rooted by Light Binding. It cleanses the root.
Hit Lux with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she walks up to cast. It knocks her back and slows her, and it refunds some mana if it hits.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before a trade. The shield absorbs some of the damage from Lux's spells and the speed helps them dodge.
Stay close to your carry. Milio has few ways to move without allies, and Maokai can catch you alone with Twisted Advance.
Hit Maokai with Ultra Mega Fire Kick to stop him closing in; it knocks him back and stuns him.
Save Breath of Life for when Nature's Grasp or Twisted Advance catches your team; it cleanses the root.
Do not spend spells on Maokai without reason; each hit shortens his Sap Magic cooldown so he heals sooner.
Stay out of brush near Sapling Toss; it chases you and deals more damage there.
Kick Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Mel only after she has used Rebuttal. Otherwise she destroys the fireball.
Stay close to your carry so your abilities have allies to work with. Mel's Solar Snare is much easier to land on you when you wander alone.
Save Breath of Life for when Mel roots your team. It cleanses the root and gives you tenacity.
Back off for a moment when Mel's hits pile up. Her Overwhelm stacks can execute you at low health, and they fall off if she stops hitting you.
Stay behind your minions so Dark Binding hits them first and stops there. Step out only when you want to trade.
Keep your ally close; alone, you are an easy target for Morgana's root.
Hold Breath of Life for when Morgana lands Soul Shackles; it cleanses the stun if you cast it before the chains break.
Hit Morgana with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she shields herself. Black Shield only absorbs magic damage but blocks the knockback and stun.
Use Warm Hugs on an ally who is low on health; it gives a shield and speed to leave Tormented Shadow.
Walk out of the path of Tidal Wave. It is slow, so sidestep it and do not cast into it.
Keep an eye on Nami's Aqua Prison. Once she misses it, it is on a long cooldown, so push up and trade.
Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Nami when she walks forward. It knocks her back and slows her with the blast.
Give your carry Warm Hugs before a trade. The shield and speed help them dodge Nami's bubble and stay in the fight.
Avoid fighting a champion Nami has given Tidecaller's Blessing. It runs out quickly, so wait it out.
Stay near your ally; Cozy Campfire gives them extra range to poke Nami from further away.
Stay behind your ADC or minions so Nautilus cannot easily line up Dredge Line on you.
Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Nautilus when he walks up; it knocks him back and leaves him slowed.
Save Breath of Life for when Nautilus lands Depth Charge on your carry; it clears the crowd control.
Do not let Nautilus attack you first; Staggering Blow roots you in place.
Keep your partner close, since Milio is slow and weak alone. Stay behind them so Neeko can't reach you with Tangle-Barbs.
Don't stand behind minions when Neeko is nearby; Tangle-Barbs grows stronger after it hits one.
Save Breath of Life for Neeko's Pop Blossom; it cleanses the stun and knock up from your team.
Be wary of allies who look odd: Neeko can pose as a friend, and Pop Blossom shows no warning while she is disguised.
Hit Neeko with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she walks up to trade. It stuns her and slows her.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Pantheon as he jumps in; it stuns him and slows him after.
Stay near your partner; alone you are easy for Pantheon to catch.
Put Warm Hugs on your partner before Pantheon jumps; the shield soaks the stun hit and the boost helps them escape.
Use Breath of Life after Pantheon's Shield Vault stuns your partner; it cleanses the stun and heals them.
Get away from the landing area when Pantheon starts Grand Starfall; it warns you before he lands.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Poppy when she walks up. It knocks her back and stuns her before she can reach you.
Stay away from walls. Poppy can use Heroic Charge to carry you into one and stun you.
Don't rely on dashes near Poppy when Steadfast Presence is up. It stops the dash and leaves you slowed.
When Poppy starts spinning her hammer for Keeper's Verdict, keep Breath of Life ready. It cleanses but won't free anyone already in the air.
Step on Poppy's dropped buckler to destroy it and deny her shield.
Stay near your ally so Pyke cannot pull you alone with Bone Skewer.
Put Warm Hugs on yourself or your ally when Pyke dives in; the shield absorbs part of his burst.
Hit Pyke with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he comes forward; it knocks him back and slows him.
Sharks under your feet mean Pyke is hiding nearby from Ghostwater Dive; keep your team close and be ready to shield.
Keep low-health allies away from you; Death From Below can execute them and pull Pyke onto you.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Rakan when he lands next to his partner; it stuns him and the blast slows everyone nearby.
Hold Breath of Life for when Rakan's Grand Entrance or The Quickness catches your team; it cleanses most crowd control, but not knock ups.
Stay close to your carry so Rakan has a hard time diving you; Warm Hugs on yourself helps when he charges in.
Use Cozy Campfire on your carry in trades; the extra range lets them hit Rakan from further away.
Stay close to your ally. Alone, you are easy for Rell to catch.
Put Warm Hugs on yourself or your ally before Rell's Shattering Strike lands. She wants to pop shields, so don't count on one shield to save you.
Hit Rell with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when she lands from Ferromancy: Crash Down or mounts up. The knockback stuns her and cuts the fight short.
Save Breath of Life for when Magnet Storm or a stun catches your team. It cleanses most crowd control and gives tenacity.
Keep Cozy Campfire on your carry and fight at long range. Rell has to cross that distance to reach you.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Senna when she walks up to attack. It stuns her, and the explosion slows her.
Stay out of Last Embrace's path. Keep a minion in front of you, because it hits the first enemy in its path.
Keep Warm Hugs ready for your carry when Senna goes for Last Embrace. The shield and speed help them walk out of the root.
Hold Breath of Life for the root or a Dawning Shadow. It cleanses crowd control and heals, and you can use it at the right moment.
Use Cozy Campfire on your carry so they can outrange Senna's poke. It also heals them.
Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Seraphine when she steps up; it knocks her back and slows her, which makes her easy to hit.
Dodge Beat Drop sideways; it is a long line, so do not walk straight at Seraphine when she has it ready.
Save Breath of Life for Encore; it cleanses the charm and your team can move again.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Seraphine trades; the Shield absorbs her High Note poke.
Stay near your carry and use Cozy Campfire; extra attack range lets you answer her poke.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Shen when he walks up; the stun gives your ally time to hit him.
Stay near your ally; Shen wants to catch you alone with Shadow Dash and taunt you.
Watch for Shen's Twilight Assault; his next attacks reach farther and hurt more, so back off from them.
Hold Breath of Life for a Shen taunt on your carry; it cleanses most crowd control.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Sona when she walks forward to poke. It knocks her back and leaves her slowed.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Sona's poke lands. The shield soaks the damage and the move speed helps them dodge.
Keep Breath of Life for after Crescendo hits your team. It cleanses the stun, though it takes a moment to cast.
Use Cozy Campfire when you fight Sona. The extra attack range lets your carry hit back at her from farther away.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Soraka when she steps forward to Starcall. The stun cancels her poke and sets up a trade.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Equinox lands. The shield soaks the damage and the speed helps them walk out.
Save Breath of Life for when Equinox roots your team. It cleanses the root and the silence.
Soraka pays health to heal with Astral Infusion unless Starcall has hit. Punish her when she is low.
Stay out of Nevermove's line when Swain is near your minions. If you get rooted, press Breath of Life to cleanse it.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Swain when he comes in to cast. It knocks him back and slows him.
Put Warm Hugs on your partner before Swain's Death's Hand lands. The shield soaks up the poke.
Move as soon as Vision of Empire shows up on the ground. It explodes after a long delay and is easy to walk out of.
Use Cozy Campfire in trades so your partner can hit Swain from farther away. It also heals while you fight.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Tahm Kench when he walks up to trade. It knocks him back and stuns him, which ruins his engage.
Tahm Kench can pull you in and swallow you after three hits. Stay away from his Tongue Lash once he has stacked An Acquired Taste.
Keep Breath of Life for when Tahm Kench stuns or knocks up your carry, since it cleanses them. It does not free anyone from Devour.
Stay away from your carry when Tahm Kench's Abyssal Dive is coming. Its target area shows up partway through the channel, so you can step out of it.
Put Warm Hugs on yourself or your carry before a trade. Tahm Kench's damage turns into stored health, so a shield cuts his damage short.
Hit Taric with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he walks up to attack minions. He is slowed and knocked back, so he cannot use Bravado.
Move as soon as you see Dazzle's wind-up. Its stun lands after a delay, so you can step out of the beam.
Keep Breath of Life for when you or your partner is stunned. It cleanses the stun.
Use Cozy Campfire to give your partner extra attack range so they can poke Taric from farther away.
Keep Ultra Mega Fire Kick for when Thresh walks up to hit a minion. The hit knocks him back and gives you room.
Hold Warm Hugs for when Death Sentence is thrown at your carry. Fast movement and a shield make the pull easier to avoid.
Stay behind your minions, because Death Sentence stops at the first unit it hits.
Keep Breath of Life ready in fights. It cleanses a stun from Death Sentence on your carry.
Stay close to your ally. Thresh will look for you alone, with no one to protect you or help you move.
Stun Vel'Koz with Ultra Mega Fire Kick when he walks up; he has little mobility to escape it.
Put Warm Hugs on your carry before Vel'Koz fires; the shield soaks his poke and the speed helps dodge it.
Save Breath of Life for when Vel'Koz stuns your team; it cleanses most stuns and slows, though not knock ups.
Stay out of Plasma Fission's line, and stay close to your carry; Vel'Koz hits hard if left alone.
Close the distance on Xerath; he is weak up close, and most champions that reach him trade well.
Hit Xerath with Ultra Mega Fire Kick; it knocks him back and stuns him, which stops him casting while you close in.
Put Warm Hugs on yourself or your ally for the move speed, and sidestep Shocking Orb, which flies in a straight line.
Keep Breath of Life for when Shocking Orb stuns you or your carry; it cleanses the stun.
Start dodging as soon as you see Xerath's Rite of the Arcane begin; the shots land after a delay, so keep moving.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Yuumi's partner when she is attached, because you can't hit her. A stun on the partner stops their engage.
Use Ultra Mega Fire Kick on Yuumi when she is loose, because a stun while she dashes with You and Me! knocks her down.
Use Warm Hugs on your carry when Prowling Projectile is coming. The shield and extra speed help them trade and escape.
Save Breath of Life for when Final Chapter and Prowling Projectile slow your team. It cleanses the slows and heals everyone nearby.
Don't stand still where Zilean can reach you with Time Bomb. Step out of the area once it sticks, because it explodes after a short delay.
Watch for Zilean using Rewind to cast Time Bomb twice. Move away from your carry so the stun doesn't catch you both.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Zilean when he steps up to throw a bomb. It knocks him back and slows him, and you get some mana back if it hits.
Use Warm Hugs on yourself or your carry to get a shield and some speed away from Zilean's Time Warp slow.
Use Breath of Life when Zilean's bomb stun lands on you and your carry. It cleanses the stun.
Zilean is fragile, so focus him as a team. Wait for Chronoshift to end before you land the killing blow on his ally.
Stay behind your minions when Zyra has a seed nearby, so Grasping Roots hits them first and not you.
Keep Breath of Life ready for when Zyra roots your team or uses Stranglethorns; it cleanses most disables but not a knock up.
Hit Zyra's plants with attacks and abilities; they have little health and expire fast, so kill them.
Aim Ultra Mega Fire Kick at Zyra when she steps up to plant seeds; it stuns her and the explosion slows her.
Put Cozy Campfire on your carry for extra attack range so you can trade with Zyra from farther away.
